Travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, hotels, activity companies and tourism businesses that sell Japan-related products or want to be discovered for Japan travel intent.

title: ChatGPTやGeminiで「おすすめ」を聞かれたとき、御社は候補に入りますか？｜AI検索対応診断

content:
旅行や店舗探しの入口は、Google検索だけではなくなりつつあります。ChatGPTやGeminiなどのAIに「おすすめ」を聞き、その回答から候補を絞る人が増えています。
そこでJPNentryでは、宿泊施設、観光施設、アクティビティ、レンタカー、フォトウェディングなどの事業者様向けに「AI検索対応診断」を開始しました。
この診断で確認すること
・AI検索で、御社がどのような事業者として理解されやすいか

検索順位や売上を保証するサービスではありません。公開情報をもとに、AI検索時代に備えるための診断・改善提案を行います。

content:
JPNentry FIELD — Real-World Pilot Testing in JapanTest in Japan before you scale. JPNentry FIELD connects companies with real operating environments in Japan and coordinates the work from pilot design to local outreach, implementation support, feedback collection, and a concise result report.
Sendai is our primary operating base. Ishigaki and Yaeyama projects are coordinated with local partners on a project basis. We do not represent that we maintain a permanent office or facility in Ishigaki.
What JPNentry FIELD doesWe help companies that already have a product or service but need a realistic place to validate it. Typical projects include SaaS and AI, hospitality technology, multilingual and inbound services, mobility and logistics, retail and food-service concepts, sports and fitness, education, and other B2B services.
How the pilot works1. Define the business question to validate. 2. Identify the right type of host site. 3. Approach and coordinate candidate partners. 4. Run a limited pilot with an agreed scope. 5. Collect operational and user feedback. 6. Summarize outcomes and the next commercial action.
Pilot areasSendai / Miyagi: primary operating base for urban, retail, hospitality, sports, education and community pilots.
Ishigaki / Yaeyama: project-based field coordination with local partners, particularly for tourism, hospitality, inbound and island-market use cases.
Other Japan: considered case by case when the project has a clear target and practical implementation path.
Commercial structureFIELD START — ¥55,000 one-time. Initial requirement review, pilot design, feasibility check, host profile definition and outreach preparation.
PILOT — typically ¥165,000–¥330,000. Scope varies by number of sites, implementation work, data collection and local coordination, so we provide a written quote before payment.
FIELD PARTNER — from ¥110,000/month. Ongoing partner development, outreach, coordination and reporting within an agreed monthly scope. Larger scopes are quoted separately.
Any success fee is used only when separately defined and agreed in writing before the relevant activity.
For companies: apply for a pilotPilot Application / 実証導入相談: https://www.jotform.com/build/262658302059055
We first review fit and feasibility. Submitting the form does not create a contract or payment obligation.
For hotels, stores and local operators: become a host partnerHost Partner Registration / 実証受入パートナー登録: https://www.jotform.com/build/262658250225052
Registration is free and does not obligate your organization to accept any pilot. Each project is reviewed individually and must be approved before implementation.
Payment after scope approvalFIELD START payment: https://buy.stripe.com/00w6oH7CT5Db2Z16gH0VO0Y
FIELD PARTNER monthly payment: https://buy.stripe.com/28EfZhaP5fdLdDFeNd0VO0Z
Do not submit card details, passwords, API keys or other confidential credentials through the application forms. Payment is handled through Stripe after scope confirmation.
日本語概要JPNentry FIELDは、企業の商品・サービスを日本の実際の現場で小さく検証するための実証支援サービスです。仙台を主な運営拠点とし、石垣・八重山は現地パートナーと連携するプロジェクト型で対応します。実証先候補の開拓、調整、導入支援、フィードバック収集、結果整理までを一つの流れで支援します。

content:
Adding Ishigaki to a Japan programme does not require replacing an existing DMC or supplier network. In many cases, the better model is to keep the main Japan partner and add one local route only for Ishigaki and Yaeyama.
Where local gaps usually appearSmall hotels or villas outside normal inventory, exact rental-car conditions, diving or marine availability, local experiences, short-notice alternatives, and services that require direct local confirmation.
A better operating model1. Keep your existing Japan DMC. 2. Send JPNentry one Ishigaki-specific brief. 3. We structure the requirement and identify a realistic local route. 4. The operating supplier confirms live price, availability, cancellation and payment terms. 5. You decide whether the option is commercially useful.
What makes a quote-ready briefTravel dates, traveler count, service category, pickup or area, preferred quality level, budget or pricing type, special requirements and decision deadline.
Try one caseThere is no need to begin with a broad partnership. One live Ishigaki or Yaeyama requirement is enough to test the workflow. RFQ: https://form.jotform.com/262640202163041

現在の重点地域石垣島・八重山、宮古島を中心に営業モデルを運用しています。地域追加は、供給条件・法令・営業体制を確認しながら段階的に行います。
JPNentryが公的機関ではないことJPNentryは、石垣市、宮古島市、沖縄県、観光協会、商工会、その他の行政・公的団体の一部ではありません。また、それらの団体からの委託・認定・提携があるように表示しません。
営業先・取引先への約束確認できない実績、在庫、価格、成果、提携関係等を事実として表示しません。料金・役割・成果定義・支払条件は、費用が発生する前に確認します。一度提示した商談条件は、相手の承諾なく差し替えません。
旅行関連サービスについて現在の石垣島・宮古島海外営業デスクは、海外営業・翻訳・見込み客紹介を行うサービスです。本サービスとして旅行者の予約代金を受領したり、宿泊・運送の予約・手配を行うものではありません。
